svg.aria-label: The 16 steps of the window with their timestep and signal and noise scales, empty rose d_t tiles for two labels, and three stacks: S(3), S(7) and their sum.
svg.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Sixteen sampler steps, one d per label each, stacked into a score path
Steps 0 to 15 are the first 16 of DDIM's 50, the window W4 trains on. Rose tiles are d_t maps: none has been computed yet.
the same real canvas with one noise draw, shown at steps 0 and 15
each tile is 1 x 32 x 64: the 3-call minus the no-digit call at that step (needs the U-Net on a GPU)
All three are read at the same x_t,
so S(3)+S(7) is exact, step by step.
Signal scale = sqrt(abar_t): the clean canvas is
x 0.0064 of x_t at step 0, x 0.0871 at step 15.
t, signal and noise scales: ddim_timesteps(50)[:16] and ABAR in canvas_unet.py, via numbers.json. v2_learn.py's other window, t = 712 to 480, is SDXL's noise level; X4 picks one.
